queryLog.query: home-service roof cleaning, gutter clearing, leak checks, and seasonal maintenance service marketing website homepage quote CTA landing page website inspiration
quote CTA homepage with trust proof, service or product menu, and local customer decision path website
premium credible owner-led service business landing page website
quote-first CTA homeowner problem routing safety/legal wording risk responsive mobile-first homepage website not dashboard not app

rawCandidates.selectionReason: Quote-first task entry with homeowner-style problem chips and a strong one-line request field.
Marketplace home-service hero shows how to sell action speed while keeping categories visible.
Risk and compliance card structure maps well to safety-led home maintenance proof.
Address-first quote step gives a clean model for location-dependent service estimates.
FAQ and dark quote CTA band show how to pair caution copy with a decisive action.
Quote module, benefit cards, and light illustration style are useful for non-photo service routing.
Minimal progressive stepper is useful for a quote flow that starts with location and service type.
Owner-led service menu row and restrained portfolio structure fit a small specialist operator.
Service detail panel shows clean contact CTA, duration, and compact fact chips.
Local area directory and owner CTA block are useful as a location-service footer reference.
Quote CTA and trusted-by strip are useful only after removing unsupported logo proof.
Insurance quote copy and benefit icons are relevant, but the admin shell makes it an anti-reference.
Product photo offer panel is useful as an anti-reference for image-led service pages without owner photos.
Outcome-stat hero is a strong warning against invented performance claims.
Generic AI service-card layout is useful as an anti-reference for template sameness.
Template service-pricing panel helps reject generic productized service sections.

ingredientLedger.ingredient: Make the first job a homeowner problem statement: gutters, moss, leak check, or seasonal roofcare quote.
Start with quote entry and problem chips, then move into service fit, safety notes, and proof.
Use a broad hero with a dominant request field and quick service chips below it.
Collapse the request field and chips into stacked mobile tap targets with one visible quote CTA.
Primary CTA should ask for quote details, not promise instant booking or fixed pricing.

bannedUses: Do not copy Airtasker's marketplace promise, blue brand system, tasker economics, fake task prices, or broad gig categories.

ingredientLedger.ingredient: Frame services around homeowner risk reduction: blocked gutters, roof moss, leak checks, and maintenance timing.
Use plain safety language and practical outcomes instead of fear-heavy emergency copy.
Soft neutral panels can separate risk, service, and quote information without turning the whole page into cards.
Keep proof panels shallow and quiet so the quote action remains more important than decoration.
Use process proof and safety steps only; hold reviews, guarantees, insurance, or years-in-business until source-backed.
Visible service names and risk language should map cleanly to agent-readable service facts.
Every trust cue must be owner-approved before it appears in visible or markdown content.

bannedUses: Do not copy Care.com's caregiver payroll claims, guarantee language, reviews, star ratings, prices, compliance guarantees, or human photos.

ingredientLedger.ingredient: Quote form needs label, local area, service type, optional notes, privacy reassurance, and a clear next button.
Include empty, focus, selected service, invalid contact, submitting, and sent states.
Progressive quote capture can start with suburb or service problem before asking for contact details.
Use a short quote form that captures the visit reason without implying guaranteed availability or price.
Inputs need real labels, keyboard focus, error text, and touch targets large enough for mobile homeowners.
Use Auckland suburb, NZ phone, and seasonal maintenance wording rather than US address defaults.

bannedUses: Do not copy watch-insurance wording, exact quote steps, policy/legal disclaimers, luxury product framing, or Chubb-backed trust language.

ingredientLedger.ingredient: Use a controlled safety/action accent for quote actions and service chips, balanced by white and weathered roof neutrals.
Use rounded quote containers sparingly; service cards can be softer while CTAs stay crisp.
When owner photos are unavailable, use roofline, ladder, gutter, and weather artifact graphics instead of fake crew photos.
Icons should clarify water flow, moss, leak, ladder safety, location, and quote step only.
Illustrations can carry service context, but must stay practical and not cartoonish for a safety-sensitive home service.

bannedUses: Do not copy travel insurance messaging, vacation imagery, global coverage claims, orange Klook identity, or illustrated luggage assets.

ingredientLedger.ingredient: Any motion should be functional: advancing quote steps, revealing the next field, or confirming submission.
Step indicators should show current, completed, disabled, and error states without hiding the task.
A short multi-step flow can reduce cognitive load when service type, suburb, and contact are all required.
The quote path should be static-first and light, without video backgrounds or heavy app-shell dependencies.

bannedUses: Do not copy Origin's financial-planning flow, state selector, account framing, subscription copy, or sparse page as an empty aesthetic.

ingredientLedger.ingredient: Use confident plain headings and compact service labels instead of overbuilt contractor display type.
Give service rows enough vertical room for problem, visit type, and next action without crowding mobile.
Use fine borders and quiet panels for service comparison rather than glossy cards.
Tokenize service-row height, border, action color, chip gap, and field radius for consistent build output.

bannedUses: Do not copy Contra portfolios, creative-service pricing, project images, freelancer marketplace UI, or exact service-row proportions.

ingredientLedger.ingredient: Use FAQ rows for safety, access, moss treatment, rain delays, and quote expectations.
Answer homeowner concerns directly without legal overreach or scare tactics.
A single darker final-CTA band can create urgency without turning the entire page heavy.
FAQ clarity can act as proof while real reviews, licenses, and guarantees are unavailable.

bannedUses: Do not copy watch collection insurance claims, appraisal copy, investment protection language, dark watch imagery, or guaranteed coverage language.

ingredientLedger.ingredient: Footer and service-area copy should name Auckland areas only when owner-approved.
Service-area browsing belongs below quote intent, not above the first action.
Location lists need readable grouping and should not become dense link farms on mobile.
Service-area structure should support local search and agent answers without adding unverified suburbs.

bannedUses: Do not copy restaurant city directories, reservation inventory, dining photography, marketplace proof, or restaurateur recruitment language.

antiReferences.rejectionReason: Business-dashboard shell and left navigation are not customer-facing home-service page references.
Food-product photography and discount offer mechanics would create the wrong proof model for no-photo roofcare.
Large outcome statistics and treatment claims would invite fake maintenance results or safety claims.
Generic AI-generated agency service cards would make the roofcare page look template-made and untrustworthy.

remixDirection.summary: A quote-first Auckland roofcare page with homeowner problem routing, practical safety/proof panels, a short progressive quote path, and no-photo roofline/maintenance graphics instead of fake crew imagery.
selectedMoves: Airtasker-style problem-entry hero, rebuilt around gutter, moss, leak-check, and seasonal maintenance quote paths.
HODINKEE-style progressive quote capture, localized for Auckland service area and contact details.
Care.com-style risk-reduction cards rewritten as source-safe maintenance and safety clarity.
Klook-style illustrated quote module adapted into practical roof, gutter, ladder, and weather artifacts.
Contra-style owner-led service rows for clear comparison without fake prices or credentials.
explicitRejects: No invented reviews, guarantees, insurance, license claims, emergency availability, fixed prices, or before-and-after outcomes.
No fake crew photos, roof photos, logos, badges, or suburb/service-area claims without owner approval.
No dashboard UI, marketplace economics, exact layouts, copied brand colors, or source-brand claims.
